title: Two men on a motorcycle killed in a highway ambush in Poblacion, Datu Paglas
summary: Ali Madsid Mling and Akmad Matabalao Pendililang were riding a motorcycle together on the highway at Sitio Olongapo, Barangay Poblacion, Datu Paglas, Maguindanao del Sur, on the afternoon of Monday, 9 November 2026, when gunmen waiting there opened fire. Both died at the scene of multiple gunshot wounds. The gunmen fled on motorcycles; the Maguindanao del Sur police had not named them or a motive.
